content: If you think you are too small to make a difference, try spending the night with a mosquito.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: A mosquito weighs less than a milligram and possesses zero armor, yet its relentless, high-pitched buzz can keep a seven-foot warrior awake and thrashing all night long. Never let feelings of insignificance keep you from speaking truth and persisting in good deeds.
practicalInsight: Take one small, determined stand for truth or kindness today, no matter how tiny your voice feels.
reflectionPrompt: Where have you given up on taking action because you convinced yourself that 'one person can't change anything'?
